Small cell lung cancer tends to spread quickly, but it also often responds well initially to chemotherapy. You will need to meet with an oncologist (cancer specialist) to discuss treatment options, which typically include chemotherapy with or without radiation therapy. Palliative drainage of your pleural fluid may also be needed to help your breathing.
